verdict.rationale: mise documents committing a lockfile and running `mise install --locked` so that every job installs the same versions, and it has a `mise lock` command. Per-platform checksums can also be recorded. missing for 10: in-depth lockfile documentation in the pack (format, multi-platform resolution behavior), explicit evidence beyond CI jobs that it reproduces across developer machines, independent hands-on corroboration of lockfile reproducibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install dependencies from a lockfile and get the exact same resolved versions on every machine

citations.quote: For reproducible installs, commit a [lockfile](/dev-tools/mise-lock.html) and run `mise install --locked`.
Commit a lockfile and install with `mise install --locked`. Every job then installs the same versions
